Analyst Ryan Deschner upgraded the stock to Strong Buy from Outperform and raised its 12-month price target to $77 from $53 per share after Liquidia

The company markets the inhalation powder for pulmonary arterial hypertension after it agreed not to add the PH-ILD indication (pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease) to its labeling as

In a research note on Wednesday, Deschner attributed the upgrade to the “continued resilience of the impressive Yutrepia launch in PAH and PH-ILD, particularly in the PAH market, which has turned out to be substantially larger than previous estimates.”

“Although the final payment still needs to be sent before the '327 settlement is complete, we consider the legal overhang to now be removed, and we think it is very likely the Liquidia team will continue to execute commercially at a high level, even with a single-indication label (PAH)," he added.

Despite potential volatility expected over the coming quarters as the Yutrepia rollout stabilizes with PAH indication, the analyst cites a near-term blockbuster opportunity for the drug and even more room for growth with the company’s next-gen L606 platform in PAH, PH-ILD, and other indications.
